name: AI Tutor
content:
### About AI Tutor
The AI Tutor is an interactive, generative AI-powered learning assistant designed to help you think critically, debug code, and deepen your understanding of computer science concepts. In addition to asking guiding questions and helping you debug, it can also generate code directly when that best supports the learning goals of the activity. 

### Accessing AI Tutor

AI Tutor is available as a tab in the Resource Panel. If you can not access it you should ask your teacher for help.

### FAQs
What should I do if AI Tutor gives incorrect or confusing responses?
AI models can occasionally make factual or logical mistakes. When this happens, try these steps:

Reflect and verify the AI’s response rather than copy it directly.
Figure out how to identify and fix errors.
Share any concerning or confusing behavior with your teacher
